posts.title: MAAV Competes at IARC 2026
posts.excerpt: Our team traveled to compete in the International Aerial Robotics Competition, showcasing months of hard work.
posts.content:
Our team traveled to compete in the International Aerial Robotics Competition, putting months of hard work, creativity, and collaboration to the test!

This year, we started from scratch, designing and building new drones rather than reusing our previous year's designs. Our Structures team redesigned the drone and its components, our Embedded team worked on integrating its electronic systems, and our Software team developed code for autonomous flight, mine detection, and path planning to help users safely navigate a simulated minefield.

Beyond the technical challenges, the competition was an opportunity to learn, problem-solve, and grow as a team. From tackling unexpected obstacles to sharing ideas and enjoying the experience together, we gained valuable insights that will help us improve our designs and prepare for future competitions.

We’re proud of the dedication and teamwork everyone brought to this project, and we’re excited to keep building, learning, and reaching new heights. Thank you to all our team members and everyone who supported us along the way!

posts._excerpt: Join MAAV this fall! We're looking for passionate students interested in autonomous systems.
posts._content:
Join MAAV this fall! We're looking for passionate students interested in autonomous systems.

No prior experience required - just enthusiasm and willingness to learn. We have positions open on all three subteams:

- Software: Computer vision, navigation, controls
- Structures: CAD, manufacturing, testing
- Embedded: PCB design, firmware, integration

Apply through our Google Form linked on the homepage!
